name: claudetwin
description: One memory for your two Claude accounts. Pick up work from your work account in your personal one (and back) with handoffs, full history search and a /twin panel.

connector_url.description: Your ClaudeTwin connector base URL, e.g. https://claudetwin.example.com or http://localhost:8787 (no trailing slash)
connector_url.title: ClaudeTwin connector URL

account_token.description: This account's token from the connector's .env (CLAUDETWIN_WORK_TOKEN or CLAUDETWIN_PERSONAL_TOKEN)
account_token.title: Account token

env_file.title: Connector .env file (optional)
env_file.description: Used only when the URL or token above is empty: path to the connector's .env, which holds its port and both tokens
